calls.title: Duel + Growthbook Outlier Discussion
calls.summary: The meeting centered on developing an outlier detection strategy for gambling data, with a preference for the scaled interquartile range (IQR) method over fixed percentiles, as emphasized by Fraser Gray. This approach adapts to data distribution, addressing the non-normally distributed nature of gambling data. Luke Sonnet described GrowthBook's existing methods and limitations, specifically the absence of IQR support. Fraser proposed enhancements to the GrowthBook user interface, including the ability to toggle between raw and capped KPI versions. The team outlined plans for a trial starting in April, emphasizing the need for backend integration using the PHP SDK and ongoing technical support. Overall, the discussions highlighted the importance of nuanced statistical methods for making informed decisions in gambling marketing.
calls.keywords: Outlier Detection, Gambling Data, Bayesian Estimation, GrowthBook, Winsorizing, Experimentation
